module.name: Geopolitical & Security Risk Module
module.description: Real-time monitoring of political instability, terrorism, armed conflict, sanctions, trade wars, border tensions, civil unrest, and security incidents affecting trade routes, ports, and supplier locations. Integrates event streams from multiple intelligence sources.
module.expansion_logic: Base geopolitical parameters are tracked for 195+ countries, 500+ country-pair relationships, 300+ ports, 250+ trade routes, and 500+ supplier locations. Event-driven updates occur within 15 minutes of incident occurrence. Risk scores recalculated immediately upon new events.
data_sources: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project)
GDELT (Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone)
Economist Intelligence Unit Political Stability Index

parameters.name: country_political_stability_index
parameters.purpose: 0-100 political stability index for country (higher = more stable).

parameters.name: country_corruption_perceptions_index
parameters.purpose: 0-100 corruption index (higher = less corrupt).

parameters.name: country_democracy_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 democracy score (higher = more democratic).

parameters.name: country_global_peace_index_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 global peace index (higher = more peaceful).

parameters.name: country_armed_conflict_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether country is currently involved in armed conflict.

parameters.name: country_active_conflicts_count
parameters.purpose: Number of active armed conflicts in country.

parameters.name: country_conflict_fatalities_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Total fatalities from armed conflict in country in last 30 days.

parameters.name: country_conflict_intensity_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 conflict intensity score based on frequency and severity of events.

parameters.name: country_terrorism_incidents_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of terrorism incidents in country in last 30 days.

parameters.name: country_terrorism_fatalities_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Total fatalities from terrorism in country in last 30 days.

parameters.name: country_terrorism_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 terrorism risk score.

parameters.name: country_civil_unrest_events_last_7d
parameters.purpose: Number of protests, riots, demonstrations in last 7 days.

parameters.name: country_civil_unrest_severity_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 severity score of recent civil unrest.

parameters.name: country_under_international_sanctions_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether country is under international sanctions.

parameters.name: country_sanctions_severity_level
parameters.purpose: Severity level of sanctions: 0=none, 1=sectoral, 2=comprehensive, 3=total embargo.

parameters.name: country_sanctions_sectors_affected
parameters.purpose: Array of sectors affected by sanctions (e.g., ['energy', 'finance', 'technology']).

parameters.name: country_coup_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for military coup or regime change.

parameters.name: country_election_scheduled_next_90d_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether national election scheduled in next 90 days.

parameters.name: country_election_violence_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for election-related violence.

parameters.name: country_government_effectiveness_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 government effectiveness score (World Bank Governance Indicator).

parameters.name: country_rule_of_law_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 rule of law score (World Bank Governance Indicator).

parameters.name: country_regulatory_quality_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 regulatory quality score (World Bank).

parameters.name: country_border_dispute_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether country has active border disputes.

parameters.name: country_border_closure_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for sudden border closures.

parameters.name: country_pair_diplomatic_relations_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 score of diplomatic relations between origin and destination countries.

parameters.name: country_pair_trade_war_active_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether countries are engaged in trade war (tariff escalations).

parameters.name: country_pair_trade_war_tariff_increase_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage increase in tariffs due to trade war.

parameters.name: country_pair_military_tension_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 military tension score between countries.

parameters.name: country_pair_recent_conflict_events_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of conflict-related events between countries in last 30 days.

parameters.name: country_pair_war_probability_12m_percent
parameters.purpose: Estimated probability of armed conflict between countries in next 12 months.

parameters.name: route_piracy_incidents_last_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of piracy incidents along route in last 12 months.

parameters.name: route_piracy_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 piracy risk score for route.

parameters.name: route_high_risk_piracy_zone_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether route passes through designated high-risk piracy zone.

parameters.name: route_armed_guard_recommended_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether armed guards recommended for this route.

parameters.name: route_terrorism_incidents_proximity_last_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of terrorism incidents within 100km of route in last 12 months.

parameters.name: route_chokepoint_closure_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for chokepoint closure (Suez, Panama, Hormuz, Malacca, etc.).

parameters.name: route_passes_through_conflict_zone_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether route passes through active conflict zone.

parameters.name: route_conflict_zone_proximity_min_km
parameters.purpose: Minimum distance from route to nearest active conflict zone.

parameters.name: route_countries_traversed_count
parameters.purpose: Number of countries/territorial waters route passes through.

parameters.name: route_avg_country_stability_score
parameters.purpose: Average political stability score of all countries along route.

parameters.name: port_security_level_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 port security level score (ISPS compliance, infrastructure).

parameters.name: port_terrorism_incidents_last_12m
parameters.purpose: Number of terrorism incidents at port or within 10km in last 12 months.

parameters.name: port_political_unrest_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance to nearest political unrest event (last 7 days).

parameters.name: port_strike_labor_unrest_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for port labor strikes in next 30 days.

parameters.name: port_country_stability_score
parameters.purpose: Political stability score of port's country.

parameters.name: supplier_location_conflict_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance from supplier location to nearest active conflict.

parameters.name: supplier_location_conflict_events_50km_last_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of conflict events within 50km of supplier in last 30 days.

parameters.name: supplier_location_terrorism_proximity_km
parameters.purpose: Distance from supplier location to nearest terrorism incident (last 90 days).

parameters.name: supplier_location_civil_unrest_events_last_7d
parameters.purpose: Number of civil unrest events at supplier location in last 7 days.

parameters.name: supplier_country_stability_score
parameters.purpose: Political stability score of supplier's country.

parameters.name: supplier_country_under_sanctions_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier's country is under sanctions.

parameters.name: supplier_on_sanctions_list_flag
parameters.purpose: Boolean: whether supplier entity is on sanctions list (OFAC, EU, UN).

parameters.name: supplier_ownership_by_sanctioned_entity_percent
parameters.purpose: Percentage of supplier owned by sanctioned entities.

parameters.name: supplier_political_connections_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for political connections (PEP - Politically Exposed Persons).

parameters.name: supplier_labor_unrest_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for labor strikes at supplier facility.

parameters.name: supplier_expropriation_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 risk score for government expropriation of supplier assets.

parameters.name: supplier_supply_chain_tier2_risk_score
parameters.purpose: 0-100 geopolitical risk score for supplier's suppliers (Tier 2).

parameters.name: event_recent_terrorism_incidents_relevant_count_7d
parameters.purpose: Number of relevant terrorism events in last 7 days (route/supplier/port).

parameters.name: event_recent_conflict_incidents_relevant_count_7d
parameters.purpose: Number of relevant armed conflict events in last 7 days.

parameters.name: event_recent_sanctions_changes_relevant_count_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of relevant sanctions changes (new/lifted) in last 30 days.

parameters.name: event_recent_border_closures_relevant_count_30d
parameters.purpose: Number of relevant border closures in last 30 days.

parameters.name: composite_geopolitical_risk_score_country
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite geopolitical risk score for country.

parameters.name: composite_geopolitical_risk_score_route
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite geopolitical risk score for route.

parameters.name: composite_geopolitical_risk_score_supplier
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite geopolitical risk score for supplier.

parameters.name: composite_geopolitical_risk_score_rfq
parameters.purpose: 0-100 composite geopolitical risk score for entire RFQ (all routes+suppliers).
